Who should we include from your side? You listed Sally Zhao (security lead) and your IT alias — will both join the initial run-through or only for the SE portion?

- Option A: Tue Nov 24 — 09:00–10:30 PT / 12:00–13:30 ET (90m: 30m AE overview + 60m SE deep dive + 15m buffer)
- Option B: Wed Nov 25 — 13:00–14:30 PT / 16:00–17:30 ET (same split)

If neither works, tell me the blackout windows for your IT team and I’ll propose three matched slots. Also, any guest constraints (VPN only, no screen-sharing from unknown hosts) — flag them now and I’ll have our SE prepare an alternate demo path.

Thanks — I’ll hold both options for 24 hours.

— Grace

- Full interactive: needs temporary port openings (HTTPS + jump-host SSH) and 15–30 minutes of connectivity testing before the session.
- Network-isolated: I'll run the same inference flows against a local synthetic dataset and prerecorded model outputs; that removes any need for inbound changes and is safe for restricted networks.

For the technical portion, I recommend a 45–60 minute block where we:
1) Walk through the serving runtime and routing (15m)
2) Run two sample requests from your payloads (20–25m)
3) Q&A & next steps (10–20m)

If you choose the network-isolated path, please upload one small sample prompt set (JSON, <5MB) to the Drive link in my note; otherwise, we will use Redwood synthetic examples. I attached a short SE preflight checklist with fields we need filled.

Thanks — I can do Option 1 (Nov 24 12:00 ET) but prefer not to run later than 17:30 ET due to a travel window.
